# A01-S01: Party proposal

Correspondence extract. [████] marks redaction; […] marks omission.

[…]

[████]

Regarding MindFuture, I can also see that they have separated the venture fund from
the innovation center (
https://itwatch.dk/ITNyt/Brancher/venture/article13512358.ece), and that
the money is still flowing out of the enterprise. [████] The attraction has been the [████]
promise of risk capital, so if [████] closes the purse, and they still
haven't been able to present their new format, then it is probably time to look
elsewhere.

I would very much like to talk about alternative initiatives. Cool with the domain name, so
there is something to tackle. I have myself considered whether MindFuture’s mistake
might be that the organizational form non-profit/think tank does not support
the goal of a global debate at all. Think tanks support debates, but
do not start them themselves. If one were to be consistent about kicking open the door
to an 18th SDG, one should rather found a party. That one can do
more or less seriously, but there is for example no Danish branch of The
Transhumanist Party. If one founded such a party and placed an AM as
leader, then I think one can expect a strong reaction.

[████]

I’m coming to Copenhagen before Christmas, but the exact date is a bit uncertain
pt. Maybe we should talk on the phone during the week, and then I can later
write when I know when I’m coming? [████]

All the best!
